title: A Russian plan to federalise Moldova could give it a window to control access to EU membership
lede: A reported Russian plan to federalise Moldova would hand the Kremlin a lever over who joins the EU. Europe should rule it out before it reaches the table.

title: EU fund assets in sustainability categories ‘could halve under SFDR 2.0’
